feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 4 September 2026 9:58pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 04 September 2026 at 9:50pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the Viking sea area, as high pressure to the south of Ireland builds a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, decreasing west 4 or 5 late in the night, then mainly 4 occasionally 5 in places from mid-morning. Backing southwest during the afternoon, then south in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South 4, occasionally 5, increasing 5 or 6 overnight into Sunday. Veering southwest 4 to 6 later on Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming moderate into Sunday.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle overnight into Sunday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or drizzle.
